caption: The drawing features a pair of metal tongs prominently displayed in the center, rendered in gray pencil on a beige background. The tongs have slightly flattened, oval-shaped ends that curve inward and a gently arched handle with engraved decorative patterns along the upper sections. To the left of the main image, a smaller, scaled-down version of the tongs is depicted above a line marked "SCALE 1/4 INCH." At the lower right of the drawing, there is an oval detail showing a close-up of a monogrammed or inscribed area, bordered with scrollwork and the initials "JMB" in flowing script. The overall composition is plain with minimal background detail, focusing attention on the tongs and their design features.
title: Silver Sugar Tongs
